segments.name: Internet video
segments.description: Operates an online video platform in Chinese mainland, selling membership subscriptions, advertising and content distribution to viewers, advertisers and distributors.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as one operating segment and derives revenues primarily from membership services, online advertising services and content distribution through the innovative platform offering a diverse collection of high-quality internet video contents.

revenueModel.text: Subscribing members pay membership fees for premium and ad-free streaming; advertising agencies and advertisers pay for brand and performance advertising; content distribution customers pay for licensed content.
revenueModel.evidence: The Group's revenues are derived principally from membership services, online advertising services and content distribution.
